In this notebook, I will compile linear regression data into a single Excel file.

# Setup


```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)

thisseed <- 231103

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```


# Read Data

## Seurat Object

```{r}
seuobj <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_allcells_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj
```

## IL-17 Gene Sets

```{r}
il17.list <- lapply(list.files("data/decoupler/il17/wsum_kegg", full.names = T), 
                    function(thispath) read_csv(thispath, show_col_types = F))

il17.df <- plyr::ldply(il17.list)

il17.df
```

```{r}
il17.names <- c("Antimicrobial", "Chemokine", "Cytokine", "Remodeling")
names(il17.names) <- c("il17af_antimicrobial", "il17af_chemokines", "il17af_cytokines", "il17af_remodeling")
il17.names
```

```{r}
seuobj <- AddMetaData(
  seuobj,
  il17.df %>% 
    rename_with(~il17.names[.x], .cols = starts_with("il17af")) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("barcode")
)
seuobj@meta.data
```

## TCRs

```{r}
tcrs <- read_csv("data/tcr/filtered_contigs_paired_241120.csv")
tcrs
```

```{r}
seuobj <- AddMetaData(seuobj,
            tcrs %>% select(-data_folder) %>% mutate(cdr3.Paired = paste(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB, sep = "_")) %>% column_to_rownames("barcode"))
seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(celltype == "TNKILC")
```

## mTiRP

```{r}
tirp <- read_csv("out/tcr/tirp/241120_predictCOL_tirp.csv")
tirp
```

```{r}
seuobj <- AddMetaData(seuobj,
                      seuobj@meta.data %>% 
                        rownames_to_column("barcode") %>% 
                        left_join(
                          .,
                          tirp %>% distinct(cdr3, .keep_all = T), 
                          by = c("cdr3.TRB" = "cdr3")
                        ) %>% 
                        column_to_rownames("barcode") %>% 
                        filter(celltype == "TNKILC") %>% 
                        select(setdiff(colnames(tirp), "cdr3"))
            
)
seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(celltype == "TNKILC")
```

## IHC

```{r}
p20 <- readRDS("out/ihc/panimmune/panel20_long.rds")
p20
```

```{r}
p20.tojoin <- p20 %>% 
  filter(str_ends(colon_site_ihc, "-2", negate = T)) %>% # remove 2nd 001-047 sample
  filter(participant_id %in% seuobj$participant_id) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(colon_site_ihc_p20 = colon_site_ihc) %>% 
  select(participant_id, colon_site_ihc_p20, colon_site_rna, area, `BCMA+`:`NCR1+`) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = `BCMA+`:`NCR1+`, names_to = "marker", values_to = "density")
  
p20.tojoin
```

# Regressions

## IFNG vs. Th1

```{r}
ifng.stat.df <- SenderReceiver(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0"),
  senderCol = "cellsubtype",
  senderVal = c("Thelper", "NK", "CTL", "InvariantT"),
  features.sender = c("IFNG"),
  senderProp = FALSE,
  xLab = "STAT1 Expresion",
  receiverCol = "cellstate",
  receiverVal = c("TFPI2Hi Fibro.", "Inflm. Mac", "Th1", "Treg", "XCL+ NK"),
  features.receiver = c("STAT1"),
  receiverProp = FALSE,
  yLab = "IFNG Expression",
  fillVar = "antitnf_response",
  minSenderFreq = 10,
  minReceiverFreq = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_x",
  r2level = 0.999, 
  ncols = 10,
  swap_facets = T,
  doTests = F,
  exportSampleDF = T
  ) %>% 
  drop_na %>% 
  separate(senderName, into = c("group1", "feature1"), "_") %>% 
  separate(receiverName, into = c("group2", "feature2"), "_") %>% 
  rename(
    feature1_value = senderExp,
    feature2_value = receiverExp
  ) %>% 
  arrange(diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

ifng.stat.df
```

## IL17A vs. IL-17 Gene Sets

```{r}
il17a.il17sets.df <- SenderReceiver(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>% droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",
  senderCol = "cellsubtype",
  senderVal = "Thelper",
  features.sender = c("IL17A"),
  senderProp = FALSE,
  senderRelative = "cellstate",
  minSenderFreq = 10,
  receiverCol = "celltype",
  receiverVal = c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid"),
  features.receiver = unname(il17.names),
  receiverProp = FALSE,
  receiverRelative = "celltype",
  minReceiverFreq = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_x",
  facet_dir = "v",
  xVar = "diagSub",
  fillVar = "antitnf_response",
  ncol = 4,
  stripSize = 14,
  axisXsize = 16,
  axisYsize = 16,
  regSize = 5,
  groupReg = F,
  fillReg = F,
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>%
  mutate(receiverName = case_when(
    receiverName == "ColEpi_Antimicrobial" ~ "ColEpi - Antimicrobial",
    receiverName == "ColEpi_Chemokine" ~ "ColEpi - Chemokine",
    receiverName == "Stroma_Chemokine" ~ "Stroma - Chemokine",
    receiverName == "Stroma_Remodeling" ~ "Stroma - Remodeling",
    receiverName == "Myeloid_Antimicrobial" ~ "Myeloid - Antimicrobial",
    receiverName == "Myeloid_Chemokine" ~ "Myeloid - Chemokine",
    receiverName == "Myeloid_Cytokine" ~ "Myeloid - Cytokine",
    receiverName == "Myeloid_Remodeling" ~ "Myeloid - Remodeling"
  )) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(receiverName)) %>% 
  mutate(receiverName = fct_relevel(receiverName, c(
    "ColEpi - Antimicrobial",
    "ColEpi - Chemokine",
    "Stroma - Chemokine",
    "Stroma - Remodeling",
    "Myeloid - Antimicrobial",
    "Myeloid - Chemokine",
    "Myeloid - Cytokine",
    "Myeloid - Remodeling"
  ))) %>% 
  drop_na %>%
  separate(senderName, into = c("group1", "feature1"), "_") %>% 
  separate(receiverName, into = c("group2", "feature2"), " - ") %>% 
  rename(
    feature1_value = senderExp,
    feature2_value = receiverExp
  ) %>% 
  arrange(diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

il17a.il17sets.df
```

## Chemokine vs. MPO


```{r}
il17.tojoin <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>%  droplevels,
  features = il17.names,
  relative.to = "celltype",
  ncol = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  mutate(geneset = fct_recode(featureVar, !!!setNames(names(il17.names), il17.names))) %>%
  rename(genescore = meanVal) %>% 
  select(biopsy, participant_id, celltype, diagSub, antitnf_response, timepoint, geneset, genescore) 

il17.tojoin
```

```{r}
il17.p20 <- inner_join(il17.tojoin, p20.tojoin, by = "participant_id") %>% 
  arrange(biopsy)

il17.p20
```

```{r}
chemo.mpo.df <- il17.p20 %>% 
  filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>%
  filter(celltype == "ColEpi") %>% 
  filter(geneset %in% c("Chemokine")) %>% 
  filter(marker == "MPO+") %>% 
  filter(area == "EPI") %>% 
  select(biopsy, colon_site_ihc_p20, colon_site_rna, diagSub, antitnf_response, celltype, geneset, genescore, area, marker, density) %>% 
  rename(
    colon_site_ihc = colon_site_ihc_p20,
    group1 = celltype,
    feature1 = geneset,
    feature1_value = genescore,
    group2 = area,
    feature2 = marker,
    feature2_value = density
  )

chemo.mpo.df
```

## TLS-like B Cell

```{r}
tlsbcell.prop.df <- SenderReceiver(
    seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0")  %>%  droplevels,
    seurat = "seuobj",
    senderCol = "cellstate",
    senderVal = c("GC-like BC"),
    senderProp = TRUE,
    senderRelative = "cellsubtype",
    senderMinDenomFreq = 10,
    receiverCol = "cellstate",
  receiverVal = c("Prlf. BC"),
    receiverProp = TRUE,
    receiverRelative = "cellsubtype",
    receiverMinDenomFreq = 10,
    facetType = "grid",
    facet_scales = "free_x",
    facet_dir = "v",
    fillVar = "antitnf_response",
    ncol = 4,
    stripSize = 14,
    axisXsize = 16,
    axisYsize = 16,
    regSize = 5,
    groupReg = T,
    fillReg = T,
    exportSampleDF = T
) %>%
  drop_na %>%
  rename(
    feature1 = senderExp,
    feature1_value = prop.sender,
    feature1_relgroup = cellsubtype.x,
    feature1_count = annotation.freq.sender,
    feature1_relgroup_count = denominator.freq.sender,
    feature2 = receiverExp,
    feature2_value = prop.receiver,
    feature2_relgroup = cellsubtype.y,
    feature2_count = annotation.freq.receiver,
    feature2_relgroup_count = denominator.freq.receiver
  ) %>% 
  select(-senderName, -receiverName) %>% 
  relocate(feature1_value, feature1_count, feature1_relgroup, feature1_relgroup_count, .after = feature1) %>% 
  relocate(feature2_value, feature2_count, feature2_relgroup, feature2_relgroup_count, .after = feature2) %>% 
  arrange(diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

tlsbcell.prop.df
```

```{r, fig.width=26, fig.height=7}
) %>% 
  drop_na %>%
  separate(senderName, into = c("group1", "feature1"), "_") %>% 
  separate(receiverName, into = c("group2", "feature2"), "_") %>% 
  rename(
    feature1_value = senderExp,
    feature2_value = receiverExp
  ) %>% 
  arrange(feature2, diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

mtirp.th17.df
```

```{r}
regression.out <- list(

  )
  
regression.out
```
